entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

N'sah sédah danh, ô N'botou, yi Ahsah woun' naméh yi m'bésseh kn'gnonkisseh. N'dakah n'yountinéh n'wofíyi ah ponhou n'sori ah gadjatih. N'botih oubo catibi ki kouti Apouh, Oun'djoh im' koumnéh, Oune'dibih Oubahpouéh.
